density_targets.density_basis: N = BA / (pi/4 * (QMD/100)^2) per FRI stand, hectare-weighted median; MSTEMS retained as merchantable-stem cross-check
density_targets.notes: MSTEMS is a merchantable-stem subset; BA/QMD-implied total stem density is used for the whole-tree expansion. Volume check uses GBVOL.

density_targets.density_basis: median sum of measured donor expansion factors per donor plot; MB open 1970s FRI has species and age but no density field
density_targets.notes: Donor density is measured cross-jurisdiction evidence, not MB inventory density; labelled donor_density_proxy.

density_targets.density_basis: N = TOTBA / (pi/4 * (AVDI/100)^2) per polygon, hectare-weighted median; TOTMRVOL retained as the volume check
density_targets.notes: AVDI is the published average total diameter; the implied density is an arithmetic stem density, not a measured tree list.

density_targets.density_basis: EFI2020 tphmerch, grid-cell-area-weighted median; ba, bamerch and gtv retained as supporting fields and volume check
density_targets.notes: tphmerch is merchantable trees/ha; EFI volume gtv is the open volume check. Species and height still come from CLUI.
